HA.NAT.DR-SPEI.name: SPEI-12 drought depth
HA.NAT.DR-SPEI.basis: Vicente-Serrano 2010 SPEI - mean magnitude of SPEI-12 in drought months (Thornthwaite PET from ERA5 t2m); range fitted to the council span 1.38-1.74 (1.35-1.75) (10 October 2026 recheck: the earlier 0-3 range left every council between 4.6 and 5.8)

HA.NAT.DR-ARID.name: Aridity (P/PET)
HA.NAT.DR-ARID.basis: CHIRPS v3 P / Thornthwaite PET (ERA5 t2m) 1991-2020 council climatology; data range 0.53-2.8; lower=drier

HA.NAT.DR-CV.name: Rainfall variability (CV)
HA.NAT.DR-CV.basis: Nicholson 2017 - East African rainfall among the world's most variable; range fitted to the council span 0.11-0.29 (recheck 10 October 2026)

HA.NAT.DR-SEAS.name: Growing-season failure frequency
HA.NAT.DR-SEAS.basis: IPC/MUCHALI - main season < 80% of normal drives food crises

HA.NAT.DR-NDVI.name: Mean NDVI (greenness)
HA.NAT.DR-NDVI.basis: MODIS MOD13Q1 NDVI 250m 2001-2020 mean greenness (GEE); lower=sparser vegetation=drier

HA.NAT.DR-SOIL.name: Soil moisture
HA.NAT.DR-SOIL.basis: NASA-USDA SMAP 10km surface soil moisture (ssm mm) 2015-2022 mean (GEE); lower=drier; range fitted to the council span 3.93-25.4 (recheck 10 October 2026)

HA.NAT.FL-R50.name: Extreme wet days (>50 mm)
HA.NAT.FL-R50.basis: CHIRPS daily, days per year with council-mean rainfall above 50 mm, 2015-2024; range fitted to the council span 0-9.2 (recheck 10 October 2026)

HA.NAT.FL-R100.name: Very-heavy days (>100 mm)
HA.NAT.FL-R100.basis: CHIRPS daily, days per year with council-mean rainfall above 100 mm, 2015-2024; range fitted to the council span 0-2.4 (recheck 10 October 2026)

HA.NAT.FL-WLEV.name: River peak above normal
HA.NAT.FL-WLEV.basis: MoW river gauging - flood-stage exceedance height

HA.NAT.FL-BASIN.name: Basin flood records
HA.NAT.FL-BASIN.basis: Basin Water Boards (Rufiji/Wami-Ruvu/Lake Victoria/Pangani...) - recorded basin floods

HA.NAT.FL-EVENT.name: Recorded flood impact events
HA.NAT.FL-EVENT.basis: Recorded flood events 2010-2024 compiled from PMO-DMD; DesInventar; EM-DAT and press reports (data-source/flood_events.csv); to be replaced by the events the committees validate through the Data portal

HA.NAT.LS-SUSC.name: Slope susceptibility (mean)
HA.NAT.LS-SUSC.basis: SRTM mean slope per council (GEE) - steeper terrain = more landslide-prone (Usambara/S.Highlands/Kilimanjaro highest)

HA.NAT.LS-RAIN.name: Triggering rainfall (max 1-day)
HA.NAT.LS-RAIN.basis: CHIRPS daily mean-annual Rx1day 2015-2023 (GEE) - the meteorological landslide trigger

HA.NAT.ST-FREQ.name: Cyclone/strong-wind frequency
HA.NAT.ST-FREQ.basis: IBTrACS - tropical cyclone / strong-wind events on the coast

HA.NAT.ST-WIND.name: Extreme wind speed
HA.NAT.ST-WIND.basis: ERA5-Land daily max 10m wind 2015-2023 (GEE) - islands/coast highest

HA.NAT.EQ-PGA.name: Seismic hazard (PGA 475-yr)
HA.NAT.EQ-PGA.basis: GSHAP/East African Rift - peak ground acceleration 10%/50yr

HA.NAT.EQ-HIST.name: Historical seismicity density
HA.NAT.EQ-HIST.basis: GST seismic catalogue - historical earthquake density (Rift belt)

HA.NAT.EQ-FELT.name: Maximum felt intensity
HA.NAT.EQ-FELT.basis: USGS catalogue 1960-2024, M >= 4.5: maximum over events of 1.5 M - 1.5 log10(R + 15) at the council centroid (a simple intensity attenuation); records the shaking of events the GEM exposure index misses (Bukoba 2016); range fitted to the council span 5.64-7.62 (5.6-7.7)

HA.NAT.CO-WAVE.name: Significant wave height (Hs 99th pct)
HA.NAT.CO-WAVE.basis: ERA5/WaveWatch III - extreme nearshore wave energy (monsoon + cyclone swell)

HA.NAT.CO-WIND.name: Extreme onshore wind
HA.NAT.CO-WIND.basis: TMA coastal stations - strong onshore wind driving surge and overtopping

HA.NAT.CO-SURGE.name: Storm-surge frequency
HA.NAT.CO-SURGE.basis: TMA - coastal storm-surge / abnormal sea-level events (Kilwa/Mtwara/Dar/Tanga)

HA.NAT.CO-EROS.name: Shoreline retreat / erosion rate
HA.NAT.CO-EROS.basis: NEMC coastal monitoring - shoreline erosion (Bagamoyo/Pangani/Dar/Zanzibar channel)

HA.NAT.CO-MANG.name: Mangrove loss (protective buffer)
HA.NAT.CO-MANG.basis: NEMC - mangrove decline removes the natural coastal buffer  raising exposure

HA.NAT.HW-DAYS.name: Hot days (Tmax > 35C)
HA.NAT.HW-DAYS.basis: ERA5-Land daily Tmax > 35C 2015-2023 (GEE) - hot SE/interior lowlands highest; highlands ~0

HA.NAT.LI-FLASH.name: Flash density
HA.NAT.LI-FLASH.basis: Albrecht 2016 BAMS - NASA LIS/OTD flash density (Lake Victoria basin hotspot)

VU.VG.DP-UNHCR.name: Refugees and asylum-seekers hosted
VU.VG.DP-UNHCR.basis: UNHCR Tanzania operational data 2024 (camp and urban populations rounded; Nyarugusu and Nduta); a different group from the IDMC internally displaced of the workbook; logarithm and floor as the workbook IDP indicator; the workbook carries a refugees indicator (VU.VG.DP-REF) switched off, so this member keeps its own id

CC.INF.HC-DENS.name: Health facilities per 10,000 people
CC.INF.HC-DENS.basis: 2022 PHC geodatabase: dispensaries, health centres and hospitals per 10,000 people on the council polygon (drug outlets, pharmacies, traditional medicine shops and laboratories excluded; recheck 10 October 2026); range fitted to the council span 0.33-6.04 (0-6.1)

CC.INF.EDU-DENS.name: Schools per 10,000 people
CC.INF.EDU-DENS.basis: 2022 PHC geodatabase: schools from pre-primary to secondary per 10,000 people on the council polygon (recheck 10 October 2026); range fitted to the council span 1.4-18.8

CC.INS.DRR-STAT.name: DRM arrangements in place (EPRP AA EOCC ERT RVCA)
CC.INS.DRR-STAT.basis: PMO-DMD list of June 2026 (district EPRPs; drought anticipatory-action plans; regional EOCCs) and the DRR records the committees approve through the Data portal; computed by the engine from each council's recorded arrangements
